facts.text: The image is a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet on a black background, with a large cinematic scene at the top and studio turnaround and detail panels below.
White uppercase labels in the layout read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The same adult man appears throughout the panels: medium-tan complexion, lean build, shaved sides, and dark hair gathered into a small topknot at the back.
In the FACE close-up, a diagonal scar is visible above his right eyebrow on the viewer-left side of his face, and his expression is stern and neutral.
He wears a black high-collar field or tactical jacket with shoulder straps and buckle details, a black crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the HERO panel, he stands centered on a wet urban bridge or walkway at night, with metal railings on both sides and blurred city lights behind him.
The HERO scene has cool blue-gray ambient light, warm orange practical lights in the background, visible rain streaks, and reflections on the wet pavement.
The FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK panels show the figure standing straight against a dark studio background; the side view faces viewer-left, and the back view shows the small hair knot.
The JACKET COLLAR detail shows fabric, strap, and buckle hardware; the HANDS detail shows two bare hands with visible veins; the BOOTS detail shows worn black leather lace-up boots.

card.summary: A vertical character reference sheet for a dark-clad male action character. It combines a cinematic rainy-night hero shot on a bridge with studio front, side-profile, and back turnarounds, plus close-up details of the face, jacket collar, hands, and boots.

subjects.descriptor: Adult man with a lean build and close-shaved undercut, shown as the same identity across all panels.
attributes: shaved sides with dark hair gathered into a small back topknot
diagonal scar above his right eyebrow on the viewer-left side of his face
black high-collar field or tactical jacket with shoulder straps and buckles
pose: In the HERO panel, stands upright and slightly angled, with his head turned toward viewer-right and a neutral expression.
In the studio FRONT view, faces the camera directly.
In the SIDE PROFILE view, faces viewer-left in profile.
In the BACK view, faces away from the camera.
In the FACE close-up, faces the camera with a stern, neutral expression.

card.environment: The hero panel is a wet urban bridge or walkway at night with metal railings and blurred city lights; the remaining panels use a dark neutral studio backdrop.
card.lighting: Cinematic low-key lighting: cool blue-gray rain scene with warm amber background practicals; the studio panels use soft, dark, directional light.
card.framing: Vertical composite layout: a wide full-body cinematic shot at the top, three full-body studio turnaround views in a row, and four close-up detail crops in a row below.
card.style: Dark cinematic action-character concept art and photographic reference sheet, realistic.

limitations: The top hero panel contains out-of-focus background details, and the still composite cannot establish motion, sound, or dialogue.
